subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian classical dancers/dancers was/was the recipient of the Padma Bhushan award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukmini Devi Arunda.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale **was an Indian theosophist, dancer, and choreographer of the Indian classical dance form of Bharatanatyam, and a campaigner for animal welfare.
 
• One of the foremost transformative contributions that Rukmini Devi made to dance is to do with its pedagogy.
 
• She was awarded the** Padma Bhushan in 1956, and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship in 1967.**
 
• She as well worked for the re-constructed of traditional Indian arts and crafts. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/056ec66cfc54be07d04799b4392563f965e1ff411fefd0d838d677a0697a23c8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vanraj Bhatia** was an Indian writer best famous for his work in Indian New Wave cinema.​
 
• **Thanjavur Shankara Iyer** is a creative composer, concert artiste and dearest teacher. 
 
• **Vijay K Celliah** is a Producer from India.
